evaluation_support.definition: pano GT valid and covered by at least one regular view
evaluation_support.formal_primary: equal-station macro of exact solid-angle-weighted metrics

overlap_scale_synchronization.graph_constraint: weighted least squares, registered-anchor zero-mean KKT constraint, L2-to-zero
overlap_scale_synchronization.input: prediction overlap plus centrality/confidence only; no GT
overlap_scale_synchronization.pair_location: median initialization plus three Huber IRLS iterations

station_bim_scale.local_variant: same registered deterministic local correction per view
station_bim_scale.sampling: deterministic evenly spaced valid raster-order indices
station_bim_scale.scope: one universal BIM/DA3 scale shared by all regular views

geometry.projection: pinhole z-depth to same-center equirectangular radial range
geometry.single_best_view_semantics: per-ray single-source mosaic: independently choose the maximum centrality/confidence contributor at each ERP pixel

route_p_tangent_inputs.claim_boundary: Route-P uses raw DA3 only and is reported independently from Route-R BIM/direct/learned comparisons

combined_supports.common_regular: regular-only coverage intersected with valid pano GT; fixed across regular-only and both combined source sets
combined_supports.native_union: valid pano GT intersected with each source set's own coverage

identity_checks: runtime split and explicit test authorization
every tangent PNG and DA3 cache SHA256
nested14 preset K and T_face_from_pano rebuilt via shared pano_tangent
route_p_tangent_inputs.photometric_method: not applicable: all tangent RGB views are deterministic resamplings of the same panorama RGB
route_p_tangent_inputs.prediction_quantity: cached tangent perspective z-depth converted to ERP radial range

synchronization_gauge.purpose: prevent view-count changes from introducing an arbitrary global log-scale shift
synchronization_gauge.regular_plus_tangent: base-weighted zero mean over the ordered regular contributors, matching the regular-only anchor set
synchronization_gauge.tangent6_and_tangent14: base-weighted zero mean over the identical first-six cubemap views

tangent_only_supports.common_tangent6_tangent14: valid pano GT intersected with both variants; view-count quality claim
tangent_only_supports.native: valid pano GT intersected with each variant's own coverage

view_count_ablation.tangent6: first six nested14 views; exactly shared cubemap6 geometry

strict_single_frame_protocol.selector: one projected regular frame with maximum sum(base_weights)
strict_single_frame_protocol.selector_inputs: projection centrality and cached DA3 confidence only
strict_single_frame_protocol.support: selected frame coverage intersected with valid pano GT
